'''Fala''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on [[Meliflar Station]] in the [[Mendenbatt system/Legends|Mendenbatt system]]. She was the daughter of [[Hallaf]], a smuggler who owned the station. After [[Abeloth]] visited the station, she infected Fala with her [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Force energy|energy]]. This caused the crew of the station, led by [[Cardya]], to mutiny against her father. She was put into the brig along with Hallaf and there, [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] along with [[Vestara Khai]] found them. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] Skywalker healed Fala, and in her mind, Luke found the clues that Abeloth was directed to [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. The Jedi departed with the gratitude of Fala and her father.
